## Journey coverage (the fixture pass — agent-verified)

- **A1** — type "Oklahoma City" → place dossier in ≤3 clicks: hero
  typeahead → first suggestion → dossier; header/search typeahead
  returns the same place (at 390 px the header search collapses to the
  Search link by design; the leg follows it). No-JS leg: `GET` form
  contract + `/dossier/a-z/o/` fallback.
- **A2** — dossier answers with sourced values or typed absences:
  "records" wording, *Where this comes from* + share, *Next decisions*,
  page/release stamps.
- **A3** — dossier → print route: council brief with locator, permalink,
  terms, runhead (as-of + release id).
- **A4** — documents-to-bring block; *What we don't know* → queue →
  records-request task → downloadable `.draft.txt` with "SIG sends
  nothing" stated.

Result over the publishable fixtures build (515 routes): **20 passed /
4 skipped** — the four skips are the two JS-only A1 typeahead legs under
the two no-JS cells, by design; every no-JS leg ran its named equivalent.

## Self-review

- **Mechanical:** `sig-ops capstone-advocate check` → "5 committed legs
  present; 3 gated legs declared prepared_not_executed"; every gated leg
  exit-42s with its precondition + the verbatim re-run prompt;
  `cost-ledger` emits `sig.capstone-cost-read/1` (month 2026-10, GCP
  bound $100 estimate vs $300 → 33%, pending rows named). The Playwright
  battery: 20 passed / 4 by-design skips at all four cells.
- **Design:** layer honesty throughout — every fixture result labelled
  agent-verified/fixture-verified (never live, staged, hosted, public or
  "user-tested"); the journeys resolve targets from the served site so
  the spec is release-agnostic; gated legs are `prepared_not_executed`
  with named preconditions, never probed against production; the
  walkthrough packet carries a blank record table (no operator words);
  the cost read labels measured vs estimate vs pending and never sums a
  pending row; no `ingestion_permitted` flip, no `db/sqitch.plan` line,
  no spec edit, no page-type or budget change, no new island.
